name: Kinco Automation (Shanghai) Co.,Ltd
summary: Kinco Automation (Shanghai) Co.,Ltd develops, produces, and sells components for motion control and human-machine interaction in China. It offers industrial automation standards and intelligent hardware products. The company provides human machine interfaces; programmable logic controllers; motion control, which includes AC servo, DC servo, and stepper systems, as well as motion controllers; and variable frequency drives. It also offers servo drivers and servo motors, including synchronous motors and encoders. Its products are used in factory and e-commerce logistics, and medical image equipment industries.
